Dear shift leads,
At midday, the welfare lead brought up some notes on cabin readiness. Please review the boarding files with care and confirm that crate checks, water access, and transfer steps are logged before each release. If any traveler raises a concern, keep the response calm, direct, and documented so the handoff remains smooth.

For the reptile case, <<FACT F078>>. For the delayed departure file, <<FACT F109>>. For the large dog booking, <<FACT F057>>. Use the service notes to keep each record aligned with the passenger update, and escalate any mismatch at once. The Companion Animal Travel Desk must keep standards steady and communication clear.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
